title: Chroma Bath
summary: Pure non-representational color. No object at all — no blob, no sphere, no horizon, no figure. Eight segments, each a different processing dialect applied to a swirling color field: ink bleed, video feedback, slit-scan, datamosh, refraction, print misregistration, granulation, bleach. There is no black in the piece; the darkest value is a glowing indigo.
visualArc: Ink bleeding in water → feedback tunnel → slit-scan lanes → compression smear → refraction through turning glass → misregistered print → granular shatter and reassembly → everything bleaches to warm white.
